Baudhāyana
taught Kṛṣṇa Yv. an. a. of Baudh. Sūtras; a complete set of the Baudh. Sūtras has not yet been recovered; D.. Burnell arranges Baudhāyana's Sūtras into six divisions--the Śrautasūtras, Karmāntasūtras, Dvaidhasūtras, Gṛhyasūtras, Dharmasūtras an. Śulbasūtras.
In the Baudhāyanadharmasūtra (

.) Kaṇva Bodhāyana, Āpastamba Sūtrakāra an. Satyāṣādha Hiraṇyakeśin are mentioned From this Kaṇva (Kāṇva) Bodhāyana is not identical with Baudhāyana, a. of above mentioned works.
The Mysore Ed.. of the Dharma Sūtras reads the Sūtras a. that of Bodhāyana whereas the Ānandāśrama edn. reads a. that of Baudhāyana. For further details see Kane, HDS. I. Revised Ed.. p.. 38 ff.
